changes: Improves Remote lyrics timing, playback controls, artwork and adaptive layout.
Adds graceful lyric provider recovery and Host and Remote crash recovery improvements.
Fixes Build CI release signing by preserving the exact checked source identity.
Keeps the pinned Sing model verification and production artifact checks deterministic.
Stabilizes production Sing model downloads with verified range assembly.
Invalidates stale Host build caches when the pinned model fetcher changes.
Adds Host-owned Sing mode with local vocal mixing controls in the Player and Lyrics views.
Adds occurrence-bound audio commands, Core Audio capture, bounded processing, and pinned Apple Silicon MLX Mel-RoFormer separation.
Fixes the stretched pairing camera preview and scans the Host QR code with CameraX.
Refines Host onboarding and hides playback controls when no song is active.
Opens Music automatically when Cadenza Host needs to read or control playback.
Shows the Lyrics control only when lyrics are available and identifies line and word timing support.
Adds Host-owned LRCLIB lyric fallback, persistent lyric and artwork caching, and source labels on Remote.
Renames Cadence to Cadenza while preserving installed app and storage identities.
Adds Host setup for storefront detection, permissions and verified pairing.
Adds local Remote Favorites, editable device names and theme preferences.
Adds adaptive list-detail navigation, Play next and control-session status notifications.
Adds bounded local address failover and Production-only update controls.
Shows the version, build profile, source identity and build timestamp on Android startup.
